_comment: Everything site-specific lives here. This file is read from the share at deploy time, so editing it never requires rebuilding the WinPE image. Paths starting with Z: are on \\SERVER\deploy.

Image._EnablementMsu_note: Only set this when applying 24H2/25H2 media and upgrading to 26H2 (26H2 is an enablement package on that servicing branch). Example: Z:\\images\\26H2\\windows11.0-kbXXXXXXX-x64.msu

Drivers._note: Extract the Lenovo SCCM driver package (ds503742, ~5.7 GB) here. Nested folders are fine; Deploy.ps1 uses /Recurse.

PostInstall._Apps_note: winget --id values. Verify with: winget search <name>. Anything not resolvable is logged and skipped, never fatal.
PostInstall._VendorTools_note: Verify the winget id in your region first (winget search vantage). Lenovo Commercial Vantage is how you get firmware + the newer driver pieces Windows Update misses on this 2018 machine.
